headlines.title: Anthropic's profit just disappeared. That's good news
headlines.summary: Anthropic's amended S-1 shows third-quarter revenue near $17 billion, up 47%, but a $567 million operating loss and $895 billion in compute commitments. Host Ejaaz Ahamadeen breaks down why demand outran Anthropic's compute, where the money goes, whether it can pay, and whether the IPO is a buy or a sell.

headlines.title: Apple Has Gotten ‘Zero Out of AI.’ Bulls Say It Doesn’t Matter Yet.
headlines.summary: Apple just posted its best fiscal year ever without a single dollar of AI-driven revenue, and even the skeptics admit the hardware cycle is holding up. But with rivals cashing in on AI and Siri still trailing ChatGPT, how long can that last?

headlines.title: Stocks drop on AI fears, eyes on US midterms
headlines.summary: Stock markets struggled Tuesday following another AI-fuelled tech selloff on Wall Street and as investors turned their attention to the pivotal US midterm elections.  "Investors were sitting uncomfortably as they waited with bated breath for the US midterm elections," said Dan Coatsworth, head of markets at AJ Bell.

headlines.title: 2 S&P 500 stocks to consider right now and 1 we find risky
headlines.summary: The S&P 500 (^GSPC) is home to the biggest and most well-known companies in the market, making it a go-to index for investors seeking stability. But not all large-cap stocks are created equal - some are struggling with slowing growth, declining margins, or increased competition.

headlines.title: Google Recently Warned That Quantum Computers Could Crack Bitcoin. Now It's Selling Protection.
headlines.summary: Alphabet's planned crypto custody platform is catering to institutions that are increasingly concerned about their cybersecurity.

description: Alphabet Inc. offers various products and platforms in the United States, Europe, the Middle East, Africa, the Asia-Pacific, Canada, and Latin America. It operates through Google Services, Google Cloud, and Other Bets segments. The Google Services segment provides products and services, including ads, Android, Chrome, devices, Gmail, Google Drive, Google Maps, Google Photos, Google Play, Search, and YouTube. It is also involved in the sale of apps and in-app purchases and digital content in Google Play and YouTube; and devices, as well as the provision of YouTube consumer subscription services, such as YouTube TV, YouTube Music and Premium, NFL Sunday Ticket, and Google One. The Google Cloud segment offers consumption-based fees and subscriptions for AI solutions, including AI infrastructure, Vertex AI platform, and Gemini enterprise. It also provides cybersecurity, and data and analytics services; Google Workspace that include cloud-based communication and collaboration tools for enterprises, such as Calendar, Gmail, Docs, Drive, and Meet; and other enterprise services. The Other Bets segment sells transportation and internet services. Alphabet Inc. was incorporated in 1998 and is headquartered in Mountain View, California.
